body.name: randomized-jitter Gaussian-multiplier Anderson--Rubin inversion
body.construction:
Let
\[
 \mathcal K=\{d+2,\ldots,R_{\max}\},
 \qquad
 q=(E-1)|\mathcal K|,
 \qquad
 \|x\|_{\max}=\max_{k\in\mathcal K}\|x_k\|_2
\]
for a vector \(x=(x_k:k\in\mathcal K)\in\mathbb R^q\).  Each coordinate of every sample cumulant is a fixed finite linear combination of symmetric \(U\)-statistics.  For an order-\(s\) constituent with kernel \(g\) in environment \(e\), define its leave-one-out first-projection estimate by
\[
 \widehat\psi_{g,e,i}
 =
 s\left[
 {n_e-1\choose s-1}^{-1}
 \sum_{\substack{J\subset\{1,\ldots,n_e\}\setminus\{i\}\\|J|=s-1}}
 g(W_{e,i},W_{e,J})-U_{e,s}(g)
 \right].
\]
Apply the same fixed linear combinations and the environment-versus-baseline contrast signs to obtain \(\widehat\psi^C_{e,i}\), \(\widehat\psi^c_{e,k,i}\), and \(\widehat\psi^m_{e,k,i}\).  Define
\[
 \widehat C^\dagger=
 \begin{cases}
  (\widehat C^\top\widehat C)^{-1}\widehat C^\top,
    &\sigma_d(\widehat C)\geq\kappa_0/2,\\
  0,&\sigma_d(\widehat C)<\kappa_0/2,
 \end{cases}
\]
and, for \(b\in[-B,B]\),
\[
 \widehat h_k(b)=\widehat m_k-b\widehat c_k,
 \qquad
 \widehat\zeta_{e,k,i}(b)
 =
 \widehat Q\left\{
 \widehat\psi^m_{e,k,i}
 -b\widehat\psi^c_{e,k,i}
 -\widehat\psi^C_{e,i}\widehat C^\dagger\widehat h_k(b)
 \right\}.
\]
Let \(\widehat\zeta_{e,i}(b)\in\mathbb R^q\) stack these vectors over \(k\in\mathcal K\), and put
\[
 H_n(b)=
 \left(
 \sqrt n\,\widehat Q(\widehat m_k-b\widehat c_k):
 k\in\mathcal K
 \right).
\]
Set
\[
 \nu=\min\{1,\delta/R_{\max}\},\qquad
 \rho=\frac{\nu}{8+4\nu},
\]
fix \(0<\chi<\rho\), let \(\tau_n=n^{-\chi}\), and choose an integer \(m_n\to\infty\).  Independently of the data, draw mutually independent standard normal multipliers
\[
 \{\omega^{(j)}_{e,i}:e\in\mathcal E,\ 1\leq i\leq n_e,\
 1\leq j\leq m_n\}
 \quad\text{and}\quad
 \xi_0,\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_{m_n}.
\]
For each \(b\in[-B,B]\), form
\[
 G^{*(j)}_n(b)
 =
 \frac1{\sqrt n}
 \sum_{e\in\mathcal E}\sum_{i=1}^{n_e}
 \pi_e^{-1}\widehat\zeta_{e,i}(b)\omega^{(j)}_{e,i},
\]
\[
 V_n(b)=\|H_n(b)\|_{\max}+\tau_n\xi_0,
 \qquad
 V^{*(j)}_n(b)=\|G^{*(j)}_n(b)\|_{\max}+\tau_n\xi_j,
\]
and the simulated upper-tail probability
\[
 \widehat p_{n,m_n}(b)
 =
 \frac1{m_n}\sum_{j=1}^{m_n}
 \mathbf 1\{V^{*(j)}_n(b)\geq V_n(b)\}.
\]
The randomized-jitter inversion is
\[
 \mathcal C_n^{\mathrm{RJ}}
 =
 \{b\in[-B,B]:\widehat p_{n,m_n}(b)>\alpha_0\}.
\]
Equivalently, up to the empirical-quantile discrepancy of at most \(1/m_n\), accept \(b\) when \(V_n(b)\) does not exceed the empirical \((1-\alpha_0)\)-quantile of \(\{V_n^{*(j)}(b)\}_{j=1}^{m_n}\).  If an environment has fewer observations than a constituent \(U\)-statistic requires, set \(\mathcal C_n^{\mathrm{RJ}}=[-B,B]\); balanced shares make this fallback inactive for all sufficiently large \(n\).
